records.title: Opening a register
records.answer: Begin the fictional café day by opening River’s front counter with a $200.00 float.
records.scope: One register at the River location.
records.limitation: The opening float is part of the café exercise. Confirm the opening workflow for your register.
records.availability: Confirm the current package and supported workflow with Atlasade.

records.title: Building a sales ticket
records.answer: Add a house coffee and an oat bar to the café ticket. The demonstration calculates an $8.00 subtotal and $0.40 illustrative tax.
records.limitation: The two products and the illustrative tax apply to the fictional sale. Confirm your supported items and tax setup.
records.availability: Confirm the current package and supported workflow with Atlasade.

records.title: Customer lookup and attachment
records.answer: In the café, find Sam Reed and attach their profile to the ticket. The completed receipt carries the association.
records.scope: A fictional regular and one River ticket.
records.limitation: Confirm the lookup method, staff access and recorded information for your package.
records.availability: Confirm the current package and supported workflow with Atlasade.
questions: Can I attach a customer to the café sale?

records.title: Cash checkout and change
records.answer: The café accepts $10.00 in simulated cash for an $8.40 ticket and returns $1.60 in change.
records.scope: One simulated cash payment at River.
records.limitation: Confirm cash checkout and receipt support for your current setup.
records.availability: Confirm the current package and supported workflow with Atlasade.
questions: How much change does Sam get?

records.title: Location-scoped inventory
records.answer: In the River & Oak demo, selling an oat bar at River reduces River’s stock from 12 to 11. Hill stays at 9.
records.scope: Tracked oat bars at the fictional River and Hill locations.
records.limitation: This two-store comparison illustrates the sale. Confirm location-specific stock behavior for your proposed setup.
records.availability: Confirm the current package and supported workflow with Atlasade.

records.title: Daily cash reconciliation
records.answer: Count River’s closing drawer against its opening cash plus the recorded sale. A short or over count shows a variance in the exercise.
records.scope: The River register after one fictional cash sale.
records.limitation: The editable count is a teaching exercise. Confirm the daily report and closeout workflow for your setup.
